intuition: Keep the lower half and upper half balanced so their boundary values determine the median.

brute_force.approach: Insert values into a list, sort on each median query.
brute_force.time: O(n log n) add / O(n log n) query

optimal.approach: Use a max-heap for the lower half and min-heap for the upper half, rebalancing after insertion.

edge_cases: Equal heap sizes average their roots.
An odd count uses the root of the larger heap.
